title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_decadence_by_michel_onfray_cpbyr (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_decadence_by_michel_onfray_cpbyr' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package may result in full system compromise, including unauthorized access to stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but complete remediation cannot be guaranteed due to potential persistent malicious software. Secrets and keys should be rotated from a separate, uncompromised system.
